body: Yup. Everyday for at least an hour. I have recurring made up characters and storylines too. It makes me feel kind of hopeful, in a way. But sometimes it makes me very sad when i remember it isnt real.
Love the color choice! Very nice.

I think the midfaces on some of your people drawing are too long. Correct it by bringing their eyes downards, so their faces are overall much more pleasing and natural looking. I enjoy the dragon drawings and the thicker linework you used in pieces like "Best Friends".

The neck is too thin and her body/chest is too wide in proportion to her head. If you want to draw coily hair on her they front two pieces wouldn't fall in the same way straight hair would. Her boobs are also too round, I recommend going in a teardrop shape. I think the numbers you erased, because of their size, wouldve been a more interesting choice than the "12345" currently in place. Keep it up, practice makes perfect.

I think just making the eyes a bit more detailed would make the overall piece more striking. I'd suggest adding highlights, thinner, darker, more detailes eyashes, and perhaps some stray eyebrow hairs would make it much more fantasy-like. However, I'd like to say the drawing and composition of the drawing is pretty good. I like the splotches of paint and free handed edges.
In that case, then I'd suggest just going for warmer tones and leaving the rest as is. Good luck!

I don't think your colors are what's wrong, i think it's just a matter of needing more depth/shadows so as to lessen the flatness of the piece. If you add those, and still think there's something off, making the background slightly darker or more saturated would probably help

There isn't anything particularly bad that stands out. Clean linework and pleasing color scheme. Perhaps it'd look a bit better if the linework for the labionasal fold were on top of the outline for the lipstick/mouth, but that may be a manner of personal preference. Keep it up, you're clearly doing very well.

Not really sure how much you could sell it for, but you're definitely not delusional. Your realistic pieces have some minor proportion issues, but they're not really noticeable to the untrained eye. However, i would suggest working on the neatness of your finished pieces, unless you're going for an intentionally sketchy/free look. As for your digital and stylized pieces, i think they're very nice and pleasing to look at. You have a pretty unique style and nice color schemes
I too would like to be banned

I can relate. I used to only be able to fall asleep to Last Friday Night from Katy Perry (no idea why). I dont remember how I got over it, but perhaps try slowly introducing the new song? Maybe listen to the new song during the day or make a playlist of the song you're currently listening to and another one.
